2263.text: Which of the following is correct regarding respiration in adult frog?

6a7a1ff84a7e1cc11351410c.text: Based on the relative stability of oxidation states due to the inert pair effect, which of the following redox reactions is thermodynamically spontaneous in the forward direction?

Pb ⁴⁺ + Sn ²⁺ Pb ²⁺ + Sn ⁴⁺
6a7a1ff84a7e1cc11351410c.sol: Due to the inert pair effect, the stability of the lower oxidation state (+2) increases down Group 14, while the stability of the higher oxidation state (+4) decreases. Therefore, Pb ²⁺ is more stable than Pb ⁴⁺ , and Sn ⁴⁺ is more stable than Sn ²⁺ . As a result, Pb ⁴⁺ acts as a strong oxidising agent and readily accepts electrons to become Pb ²⁺ , while Sn ²⁺ acts as a reducing agent and loses electrons to become Sn ⁴⁺ .
